experiment_plans.feasibility_notes: Needs a GPU for the training run; deferred to a batch script where none is present.
experiment_plans.objective: Test whether a small transformer outperforms a bag-of-embeddings baseline on topic classification.
experiment_plans.design: Comparative benchmark of two neural architectures trained to convergence on the same split.

data_requirements.description: A labelled multi-class topic classification corpus of short news texts.
preprocessing_steps: Build a vocabulary from the training split
Pad or truncate to a fixed sequence length

methods.name: bag-of-embeddings classifier
methods.description: Mean-pooled embedding layer followed by a linear classifier.

methods.name: small transformer encoder
methods.description: Two-layer transformer encoder with learned positional embeddings.

evaluation.baseline: The bag-of-embeddings classifier trained on the same data for the same number of epochs.
evaluation.success_criteria: The transformer improves test accuracy by at least 0.03 over the bag-of-embeddings baseline.

risks: The transformer may overfit without enough data.
Training time may exceed the job's limit without checkpointing.

priority_order.justification: the only plan in this benchmark case
